title: Make reproducible owned packaging executable through GREG
problem: System53 has a standalone reproducibility proof but guarded build cannot read approved data or launch independent rebuild; registered reachability is not implemented runtime reachability.
baseline: PR147 guarded Foundry, fixed DSL, signed community and measured journeys. Source packaging standalone fixture passes, but guarded build/verify remains unfinished.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Reuse existing deterministic packager with explicit published source inventory and one fixed independent rebuild recipe.
advantages: Restores actual reproducible build/verify without arbitrary repository or child execution.
disadvantages: Inventory refresh must accompany owned source changes.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Measured packaging limitations or a stronger available owned build substrate.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Containerized fully hermetic build and OCI image pipeline.
advantages: Better dependency/runtime portability and broader isolation.
disadvantages: No available local container runtime; current source bundle pins but does not vendor third-party dependencies.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Available authorized container host and reproducibility/escape tests.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Actual guarded bundle creation and independent digest comparison plus source-inventory traversal refusal in CI.
advantages: Tests the machine execution path rather than registration.
disadvantages: A source bundle is not an OCI image or deployment acceptance.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Later owned deployment on the intended body.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Leave a falsely reachable build capability and block deployment backcast.

roles.position: Fix buildable runtime gaps and continue the complete machine after reproducibility. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: An unrestricted repository read allowance could bundle private host data.

roles.position: Reuse the current packager and fixed protocol boundary; no parallel build authority. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: A new child recipe could authorize arbitrary code or environment injection.

roles.position: Published source paths are the read contract; general filesystem containment remains unavailable. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Larger source archives could exceed a toy file cap or evade resource claims.

roles.position: Make quotas, scope, inventory refresh and independent rebuild operationally explicit. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: A stale source inventory could silently omit new machine code.

roles.position: Byte-identical source bundles establish integrity, not live installation or full product acceptance. One agent applying distinct perspectives, not independent reviews.
material_concerns: Reproducible source could be mistaken for an installed or complete machine.

evidence.claim: Restricted DSL predecessor integrated and verified
evidence.finding: All six jobs passed at5fc76e61; CI full suite1572 passed/74 skipped; V1–V5 passed. Optional dependencies are absent in the core test job; separate Cortex job runs with its solver.

counterevidence.claim: Standalone system53 exercise establishes guarded runtime reachability
counterevidence.finding: Before this delta, data-file reads and python-c independent rebuild were refused. A registry entry and component exercise were insufficient.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Execute deterministic source packaging and independent rebuild through GREG; then resume the next machine dependency.

advantages.amplified_value: Actual GREG build/verify replaces disconnected proof.
Preserves deterministic archive and toolchain mechanisms.
Buildable owned data is readable without arbitrary host reads.
Second process recomputes and compares exact bytes.
Source portability remains distinct from installation and acceptance.

disadvantages.statement: An unrestricted repository read allowance could bundle private host data.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Allow only explicit published owned-source paths; reject traversal, aliases, missing files and hard links. No caller-selected source root in guarded builds.

disadvantages.statement: A new child recipe could authorize arbitrary code or environment injection.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Allow exact interpreter/module/mode/cwd/environment/scope only. Keep unreviewed providers and source refused; fixed build child installs the same reviewed-code guard.

disadvantages.statement: Larger source archives could exceed a toy file cap or evade resource claims.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Bound each worker file to8MiB, durable stores to64MiB, input to128KiB and returned output to1MiB. State CPU limits are per process, with shared30-second group wall termination.

disadvantages.statement: A stale source inventory could silently omit new machine code.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Commit the actual published source list, test representative newly integrated files and manifest membership, and preserve deliberate refresh as an owned-source change obligation.

disadvantages.statement: Reproducible source could be mistaken for an installed or complete machine.
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Keep OCI/vendoring/platform operation requirements and founder-use evidence open; source packaging proves bytes only and does not deploy.

entries.position: Do not call this a hermetic container build or installed full machine.
entries.rationale: Third-party packages remain version-pinned, not vendored; filesystem guard is reviewed Python protection only.
entries.evidence_threshold: Working OCI host, vendored dependency/installation evidence and hostile containment tests.
entries.review_trigger: Any stronger packaging or completion claim.

Existing immutable source archives remain exportable; leave general source/provider refusal in place.
